facts.value: Provides static-storage slots used by video sequence 1101: two loaded scene-descriptor pointers, the selected character-animation archive handle, the Vi1101 archive handle, retained Mario and optional Luigi GObj pointers, and an otherwise uncharacterized eight-byte buffer. Scene entry repopulates the resource pointers; participant setup always assigns Mario's pointer but assigns Luigi's only when unlocked, without clearing it in the locked branch. These slots' storage duration does not establish the lifetime of the referenced resources. This unit contains no teardown or local use of the eight-byte buffer.
facts.rationale: Corrects sequence-lifetime wording by distinguishing static pointer storage from resource validity and explicitly preserving conditional Luigi assignment. No compiled section-layout claim is made.

evidence.why: Declares the buffer and static pointer slots.
Mario assignment is unconditional; Luigi assignment has no clearing else branch.
Entry populates resource slots; remaining callbacks provide no local teardown.
